description: This file serves as the main entry point for a ROS2 node implementing Modbus/TCP communication. It initializes and runs a ModbusNode which provides ROS2 services for reading and writing to a Modbus server and also exposes a Modbus/TCP server for external clients.

classes.name: ModbusNode
classes.description: A ROS2 node providing services to interact with a Modbus/TCP server, including methods for reading and writing registers, and exposing a server for external clients.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: The main function that initializes the ROS2 system, creates the ModbusNode, and spins it to process callbacks.
